We need to propose a retrosynthesis route (max 3 steps) to target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have template results. The first template (reaction_id 733) seems to be sulfonamide formation from aryl sulfonyl chloride (Cl-SO2-Ar) and an aniline (Ar-NH2). The product is our target where sulfonamide linking two aryl groups. Indeed our target has sulfonamide linking a tolyl (para-methyl phenyl) to a phenyl with a side chain (aryl-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH). Actually the sulfonamide attaches to a phenyl ring (c2ccc(... )cc2). So we can disconnect the sulfonamide bond: break S-N bond to give aryl sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid derivative) and an aniline.

Thus step 1: target -> sulfonyl chloride (aryl-SO2-Cl) + aniline (aryl-NH2). The template ID 733 seems to correspond to that transformation. Let's retrieve template ID? The result includes template_hash but not ID. It has reaction_id 733. Probably template_id is 733? The tool expects template_id as string. We'll assume template_id "733". Need to verify matching.

We should check if template matches target. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching.
